title: AskUserInput
description: Ask the user a question (a card on the web page). Either a plain question (question + optional options) or up to 4 structured questions (questions: each with a short header, 2-4 options with a description, one may be recommended, multi_select for several answers; the user can always type their own answer instead). Members block until the user answers and get the answer back; the coordinator and leads get the question id at once and receive "[Answer to q5] ..." as a later message. Give question or questions.

question.description: A plain question (use questions for choices with descriptions).

options.description: Suggested answers shown as buttons (with question).

questions.description: Structured questions shown as one card, like Claude Code's AskUserQuestion.

via.description: Set by the platform when Claude's built-in AskUserQuestion is routed here (the call then blocks for every tier). Do not set it yourself.
